sup:70740.subject: Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm (part:370010) – proposal for 2027 onwards
sup:70740.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for setting out your cost drivers so clearly. We value our long-standing cooperation with Blankstahl Werdenfels and would like to agree the price basis for 2027 onwards on a stable footing.

Our order history for this part with you is our starting point. Our purchase orders on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10). Our orders on 1 and 18 September 2026 were at EUR 5.84/kg (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Your quotation of EUR 6.10/kg would be a further step up from that level, and we cannot support it.

We would like to propose a package that gives you more security in return for a lower starting price:

- Unit price: EUR 4.60/kg
- Payment: 30 days net
- Contract term: 36 months
- Index clause: AS-14404, 45% material share, 0% deadband, base month 2026-08

The other terms remain as in our enquiry: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling.

The 36-month commitment gives you three years of planning security on this volume. The AS-14404 clause shares alloy-surcharge movements in both directions from the first change, so you no longer need to build material risk into a fixed price. Because the clause covers this risk, we see the starting price as the right place to review. We would like the base price to reflect the market level, without an added allowance for future alloy movements.

Does this package work for you? If any element causes difficulty, we would be glad to hear which one, so that we can look at it together.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm (part:370010) – proposal for 2027 onwards
sup:70740.body:

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

We agree to the 36-month contract term and the AS-14404 index clause, as they provide mutual planning security. In return for these terms, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.40/kg. 

Our adjusted offer stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit. As an alternative option, we can also provide a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

However, the index clause will share alloy movements with you from the base month onwards, so we believe the starting price can reflect where the alloy market stands today.

Option 1: EUR 4.98/kg, payment 30 days net, 36 months, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband, base month 2026-08.
Option 2: EUR 5.05/kg, payment 90 days net, 36 months, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband, base month 2026-08.

proposal.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer of EUR 5.50 per kg, 30 days net, 36 months, with an AS-14404 clause and 5 % deadband. We recognise this as a real step, and we are answering it with a step of our own.

On your volume question: our commitment is binding at 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling. Within the packages below, that commitment runs for the full 36 months. That is the volume we can commit to. We are not offering a forecast-based or unbound quantity.

We propose two alternative packages. Both are for 36 months, with an index clause on AS-14404, material share 45 %, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08. They are approximately equivalent for us after rounding:

A: EUR 5.31 per kg, payment 90 days net.
B: EUR 5.24 per kg, payment 30 days net.

Each price, payment term, clause and contract term is one indivisible conditional package. The third year applies only with one of these package prices.

Your key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of your pricing committee (doc:20260812-70740-M3). Please put both complete packages to the authorized pricing decision-maker and return the approved package in writing.

Which complete package can the authorized pricing decision-maker approve, or which priced term prevents approval?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for improving both structures.

On volume: our requirement is 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, as stated in our enquiry. That volume is part of each package below. With 36 months, it is committed for every one of the three years. We cannot offer a higher binding annual volume. Any further improvement therefore has to come from the price, payment and clause structure.

To be clear, 14-day payment with a 0 % deadband applies only with its own package price. It is not agreed at EUR 5.50.

In return for your movement, we have moved our prices again. All packages run for 36 months. All index clauses use AS-14404 on a 45 % material share, base month 2026-08. The packages are approximately equivalent for us after rounding:

Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for setting out your cost drivers so clearly. We value our long-standing cooperation with Blankstahl Werdenfels and would like to agree the price basis for 2027 onwards on a stable footing.

Our order history for this part with you is our starting point. Our purchase orders on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10). We would like to propose a package that gives you more security in return for a lower starting price:

- Unit price: EUR 4.60/kg
- Payment: 30 days net
- Contract term: 36 months
- Index clause: AS-14404, 45% material share, 0% deadband, base month 2026-08

The other terms remain as in our enquiry: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling.

The 36-month commitment gives you three years of planning security on this volume. The AS-14404 clause shares alloy-surcharge movements in both directions from the first change, so you no longer need to build material risk into a fixed price. Because the clause covers this risk, we see the starting price as the right place to review. We would like the base price to reflect the market level, without an added allowance for future alloy movements.

Does this package work for you? If any element causes difficulty, we would be glad to hear which one, so that we can look at it together.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
